column1: # key_servien_1632_letters.tsv -- S. Tomokiyo's recovered key "Servien-Sabran Cipher (1632)" (Abel Servien to Melchior de
# Sabran, Oct-Dec 1632, BnF Baluze 155 f.105/123/127/131/139; solved by Tomokiyo from two independently enciphered copies,
# f.123 and f.127, Cryptiana servien.htm, first posted 29 May 2021). Key table image fetched 3 Oct 2026 from
# https://cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/servien.png (468x188 px; copy in images/servien/, x3 crops key_left.png/key_right.png).
# Credit: key recovered by Satoshi Tomokiyo; transcribed here by FT4 (account-4), 3 Oct 2026, one reading of the table
# (three views of the same small digital image), self-reconciled; Tomokiyo's own "?" marks and struck-through entries
# kept in the note column, struck entries NOT used as values.
# glyph: a plain-ASCII description of the key symbol ("bar" = overbar). dc8_token: the DC8 transcription token class
# (ciphertext_draft.tsv) whose base shape the glyph matches; DC8's transcription does not record overbars, so a barred
# and an unbarred key glyph of the same base shape both map to the same DC8 token (the ambiguity servien_trial.py
# resolves by search, with the same search applied to every control). "-" = no DC8 token class of that shape.
